# Test files of ooxml

`example_password.docx` and `ecma376standard_password.docx` are Office Open
XML files that a password protects, with Agile and Standard encryption.
They come from the folder `tests/inputs` of nolze/msoffcrypto-tool, under
the MIT license, at the commit `bdb71ea5dfbdee2f3cd86f8852e74be7a6f15667`.
The license is in `LICENSE-msoffcrypto-tool.txt`. The password of each file
is `Password1234_`.
